_how_to_update: APFC staff: add each approved review to the 'reviews' list below (copy the text EXACTLY as written on Google, in its original language; never rewrite or translate; use '\u2026' at the start/end of a verbatim excerpt and set excerpt=true). Required per review: name (as shown publicly on Google), stars (1-5), text, lang (ms|en|zh|...), sourceUrl (link to the review on Google, or the listing reviews URL), when (as shown on Google, e.g. '5 months ago'), retrievedOn (YYYY-MM-DD), approved (true = APFC approved showing it), verifiedAgainstSource (true = someone compared this text with the live Google review). Reviews missing any of these are NOT shown. If the list is empty the whole section is hidden. Rating/count: update 'rating' only from the live Google listing and set retrievedOn. No paid API is used.
